catalog.label: GPU memory utilization
catalog.help: Fraction of each GPU's memory this vLLM instance may claim (weights + activations + KV cache). Startup fails if less than this is free, so engines sharing a card need a smaller value.

catalog.label: Fixed KV cache size
catalog.help: Pin the KV cache to an exact size per GPU; when set, gpu-memory-utilization is ignored. Useful for engines that share a card, because the footprint stops depending on free VRAM.

catalog.label: KV cache dtype
catalog.help: Storage type for the KV cache. fp8 roughly doubles the tokens that fit, at some accuracy risk; on sm_120 use it with FLASHINFER or TRITON_ATTN, not FLASH_ATTN.

catalog.label: KV quantization skip layers
catalog.help: Layer indices or attention types (for example sliding_window) that keep the full-precision KV cache when kv-cache-dtype is quantized.

catalog.label: CPU weight offload
catalog.help: Offload this many GiB of weights per GPU to host RAM, streamed over PCIe on every forward pass. Large slowdown; a last resort to fit a model.

catalog.label: KV offload buffer
catalog.help: Size of the host-RAM KV cache offloading buffer in GiB, summed across tensor-parallel ranks. Setting it turns offloading on.

catalog.label: KV offload backend
catalog.help: Backend for KV offloading: vLLM's native CPU offload or LMCache. Only used when kv-offloading-size is set.

catalog.label: KV block size
catalog.help: Tokens per KV cache block. Leave unset: hybrid and Mamba-style models pick a large value automatically.

catalog.label: GPU blocks override
catalog.help: Force the number of KV blocks instead of the profiled value. Meant for testing preemption.

catalog.label: Mamba cache dtype
catalog.help: dtype of the convolution and state cache of Mamba and hybrid layers. auto follows the model config.

catalog.label: Mamba SSM state dtype
catalog.help: dtype of the SSM state only (the convolution state follows mamba-cache-dtype).

catalog.label: Mamba cache mode
catalog.help: How Mamba layers cache state for prefix reuse: none (prefix caching off), all (every block boundary) or align (only the last token of each scheduler step on a block boundary).

catalog.label: Sleep mode
catalog.help: Allow releasing GPU memory while idle. The /sleep endpoints also need VLLM_SERVER_DEV_MODE, which this console deliberately never sets (it also opens an unauthenticated /collective_rpc).

catalog.label: Tensor parallel size
catalog.help: Shard each layer across this many GPUs. Without NVLink the all-reduce runs over PCIe; prefer one model per card unless the model cannot fit.

catalog.label: Pipeline parallel size
catalog.help: Split the layer stack into this many sequential stages across GPUs.

catalog.label: Data parallel size
catalog.help: Run this many full replicas (MoE layers shard over tensor x data parallel). Each replica needs its own GPUs.

catalog.label: Expert parallel
catalog.help: Shard MoE experts across GPUs instead of tensor-parallel splitting them. MoE models only.

catalog.label: Decode context parallel
catalog.help: Shard the decode KV cache of very long contexts across GPUs. Reuses the tensor-parallel ranks; adds no GPUs.

catalog.label: Expert load balancing
catalog.help: Rebalance MoE experts across ranks at runtime. Only meaningful with expert parallelism.

catalog.label: Expert placement
catalog.help: How experts are laid out across expert-parallel ranks: contiguous (linear) or interleaved (round_robin).

catalog.label: Distributed executor
catalog.help: How multi-GPU workers are launched. Left unset, vLLM uses multiprocessing (mp) on a single machine.

catalog.label: Disable custom all-reduce
catalog.help: Fall back to NCCL all-reduce. Try this if tensor parallelism hangs or corrupts output over PCIe.

catalog.label: All2All backend
catalog.help: Communication backend for expert-parallel MoE layers.

catalog.label: Dual batch overlap
catalog.help: Overlap compute and communication across two micro-batches (multi-GPU MoE).

catalog.label: NUMA bind workers
catalog.help: Pin each GPU worker process to the CPUs and memory of its GPU's NUMA node.

catalog.label: Max context length
catalog.help: Prompt plus output tokens per request. Unset derives it from the model config. vLLM refuses to start if one full-length request cannot fit in the KV cache.

catalog.label: HF config overrides (JSON)
catalog.help: JSON merged into the model's Hugging Face config, for example a YaRN rope_parameters block to extend context. A nested dict replaces the original wholesale, so restate every original key; for vision-language models target text_config.

catalog.label: Allow max-len above model max
catalog.help: Sets VLLM_ALLOW_LONG_MAX_MODEL_LEN=1 so a max-model-len beyond the config's max_position_embeddings is accepted. Quality beyond the trained length is not guaranteed.

catalog.label: Multimodal items per prompt (JSON)
catalog.help: Maximum items per modality in one request, for example {"image": 8, "video": 1}. Lower values reduce peak memory during profiling.

catalog.label: Language model only
catalog.help: Disable all multimodal inputs (every limit set to 0), skipping the vision and audio encoders.

catalog.label: Media I/O kwargs (JSON)
catalog.help: Per-modality media decoding options, for example {"video": {"num_frames": 40}}.

catalog.label: MM processor kwargs (JSON)
catalog.help: Arguments forwarded to the model's multimodal processor (for example image size limits).

catalog.label: MM processor cache
catalog.help: Host-memory cache of processed multimodal inputs, duplicated per API and engine process; 0 disables it.

catalog.label: Video pruning rate
catalog.help: Fraction of video tokens to prune from each video, in [0, 1), for models that support it.

catalog.label: Skip MM profiling
catalog.help: Skip multimodal memory profiling at startup. Faster start, but the first large image or video can run out of memory.

catalog.label: Allowed local media path
catalog.help: Directory that API requests may read images and videos from. Never '/': it lets any prompt read any file in the container.

catalog.label: Allowed media domains
catalog.help: If set, only media URLs on these domains are fetched (egress control).

catalog.label: Disable sliding window
catalog.help: Cap the context at the sliding-window size instead of using windowed attention.

catalog.label: Generation config source
catalog.help: 'auto' loads the model's generation_config.json defaults (temperature and so on); 'vllm' uses vLLM's own; or a folder path. A max_new_tokens there becomes a server-wide cap.

catalog.label: Override generation config (JSON)
catalog.help: Server-side default sampling parameters, for example {"temperature": 0.6}.

catalog.label: Max logprobs
catalog.help: Maximum log-probabilities a request may ask for per token.

catalog.label: Accept prompt embeds
catalog.help: Allow passing text embeddings instead of token ids. A wrongly shaped input can crash the engine.

catalog.label: Quantization
catalog.help: Weight quantization method. Leave unset for pre-quantized checkpoints (NVFP4, compressed-tensors, AWQ): passing fp8 for an NVFP4 checkpoint misloads it. Use fp8 to quantize a BF16 model while loading.

catalog.label: Activation dtype
catalog.help: Compute dtype. auto uses BF16 for FP32 and BF16 models and FP16 for FP16 models.

catalog.label: MoE kernel backend
catalog.help: Kernel for the MoE expert GEMMs. flashinfer_b12x targets sm_12x cards (RTX PRO 6000); an NVFP4 MoE left on auto can fall back to the slower Marlin path there.

catalog.label: Quantized linear backend
catalog.help: Kernel for quantized dense GEMMs. flashinfer_b12x is the NVFP4 path for sm_120 and newer.

catalog.label: Model revision
catalog.help: Branch, tag or commit of the model. Pin it: an unpinned main can change size or tokenizer between restarts.

catalog.label: Tokenizer override
catalog.help: Tokenizer repo or path, if it differs from the model's.

catalog.label: Tokenizer mode
catalog.help: Tokenizer implementation to use.

catalog.label: Trust remote code
catalog.help: Run Python code from the model repository. Some architectures need it; it is arbitrary code from the Hub, so only for repositories you have reviewed.

catalog.label: Model implementation
catalog.help: vLLM's own implementation, or the Transformers fallback. auto prefers vLLM's and falls back.

catalog.label: Load format
catalog.help: Weight loading format: auto, safetensors, pt, npcache, dummy, runai_streamer, sharded_state, bitsandbytes, mistral, tensorizer, instanttensor and others.

catalog.label: Safetensors load strategy
catalog.help: Unset memory-maps weights lazily (and prefetches on NFS). eager reads whole files into RAM first, prefetch warms the page cache; both help on network storage.

catalog.label: Max concurrent sequences
catalog.help: Upper bound on sequences processed in one step. Unset, vLLM picks 1024 on GPUs of 70 GiB or more (A100 excepted) and 256 on the others. Lower it for hybrid models whose state cache is small.

catalog.label: Max batched tokens
catalog.help: Token budget per scheduler step (the prefill chunk size). Larger favours throughput and long-prompt latency; smaller favours inter-token latency. Speculative decoding uses part of it for draft tokens.

catalog.label: Prefix caching
catalog.help: Reuse KV blocks for shared prompt prefixes (system prompts, agent loops). Unset: on for ordinary models, off for hybrid (Mamba-style) models.

catalog.label: Chunked prefill
catalog.help: Split long prefills into chunks so running decodes are not starved.

catalog.label: Async scheduling
catalog.help: Overlap CPU scheduling with GPU execution to remove idle gaps.

catalog.label: Scheduling policy
catalog.help: fcfs (first come, first served) or priority (requests may carry a priority; lower runs first).

catalog.label: Stream interval
catalog.help: Tokens buffered per streamed chunk; 1 is smoothest, larger values cut CPU load at high concurrency.

catalog.label: Long prefill threshold
catalog.help: With chunked prefill, prompts longer than this count as long; 0 means no cap.

catalog.label: Prefix hash algorithm
catalog.help: Hash used for prefix-cache blocks. sha256 is collision-safe across tenants; xxhash is faster.

catalog.label: Disable hybrid KV manager
catalog.help: Allocate the same KV size to every attention layer even for sliding-window or hybrid models (wastes memory).

catalog.label: Random seed
catalog.help: Global seed for reproducibility.

catalog.label: API server processes
catalog.help: How many HTTP API server processes to run; defaults to data-parallel-size.

catalog.label: Auto tool choice
catalog.help: Let the model decide when to call tools. Requires tool-call-parser.

catalog.label: Tool-call parser
catalog.help: Parser matching the model's tool-call dialect (hermes, qwen3_xml, qwen3_coder, llama3_json, openai for gpt-oss, glm47, poolside_v1, ...). A mismatch leaves raw tool markup in the message content.

catalog.label: Reasoning parser
catalog.help: Splits the chain of thought into reasoning_content (qwen3, deepseek_r1, nemotron_v3, openai_gptoss, glm45, poolside_v1, ...).

catalog.label: Chat template
catalog.help: Path or inline Jinja chat template that overrides the model's own.

catalog.label: Chat content format
catalog.help: How message content is handed to the template: auto, openai (list of parts) or string.

catalog.label: Default template kwargs (JSON)
catalog.help: Server default kwargs for the chat template, for example {"enable_thinking": false}.

catalog.label: Hide tools when tool_choice=none
catalog.help: Drop tool definitions from the prompt when tool_choice is 'none'.

catalog.label: Tool parser plugin
catalog.help: Path to a Python file that registers a custom tool parser.

catalog.label: Reasoning parser plugin
catalog.help: Path to a Python file that registers a custom reasoning parser.

catalog.label: Structured outputs config (JSON)
catalog.help: Guided-decoding configuration, for example {"backend": "xgrammar"}.

catalog.label: Response role
catalog.help: Role name of generated messages.

catalog.label: Enforce eager mode
catalog.help: Disable CUDA graphs. Saves about 1 GiB and start-up time, costs decode speed. Debugging only.

catalog.label: Performance mode
catalog.help: balanced; interactivity (fine-grained CUDA graphs, latency kernels); or throughput (larger graphs, aggressive batching).

catalog.label: Optimization level
catalog.help: 0 = fastest start-up, 3 = best steady-state speed (more compile effort). The default is 2.

catalog.label: Compilation config (JSON)
catalog.help: torch.compile and CUDA-graph settings, for example {"mode": 3, "cudagraph_capture_sizes": [1, 2, 4, 8]}.

catalog.label: CUDA graph capture sizes
catalog.help: Batch sizes to capture as CUDA graphs. Fewer sizes mean a faster start and less graph memory.

catalog.label: Max CUDA graph size
catalog.help: Largest batch size captured as a CUDA graph. Unset: min(max-num-seqs x 2, 512).

catalog.label: Attention backend
catalog.help: Attention kernel. On sm_120 FLASH_ATTN runs FlashAttention 2, which cannot use an fp8 KV cache; FLASHINFER and TRITON_ATTN can. Replaces the old VLLM_ATTENTION_BACKEND variable.

catalog.label: FlashInfer autotune
catalog.help: Run FlashInfer autotuning during warm-up (results are cached across restarts). Unset lets vLLM decide.

catalog.label: Mamba SSU backend
catalog.help: Kernel backend for Mamba selective-state updates: triton (the default) or flashinfer.

catalog.label: GDN prefill backend
catalog.help: Prefill kernel for gated-delta-net (linear attention) layers, as in Qwen3.5 and 3.8.

catalog.label: Speculative decoding config (JSON)
catalog.help: Full speculative-decoding config, for example {"method":"mtp","num_speculative_tokens":2}, or a draft model with its revision pinned. Cannot be combined with the spec_* shortcuts.

catalog.label: Speculative method
catalog.help: Shortcut: the speculation method (mtp, eagle3, ngram, dflash, dspark, draft_model, ...).

catalog.label: Draft model
catalog.help: Shortcut: the draft model or EAGLE head repository.

catalog.label: Speculative tokens
catalog.help: Shortcut: draft tokens per step.

catalog.label: Extra model names
catalog.help: Extra names the API answers to. The console always serves its own name first.

catalog.label: API key
catalog.help: Require this bearer key. Passed through the VLLM_API_KEY environment variable, never on the command line, so it does not show in the process list.

catalog.label: Uvicorn log level
catalog.help: Log level of the HTTP server.

catalog.label: Silence access log for paths
catalog.help: Comma-separated paths to leave out of the access log, for example /health,/metrics (the console polls both).

catalog.label: Request-ID headers
catalog.help: Add an X-Request-Id header to responses.

catalog.label: Prompt token details
catalog.help: Return the number of cached prompt tokens in the usage block.

catalog.label: Server load tracking
catalog.help: Expose the number of in-flight requests at /load.

catalog.label: Log requests
catalog.help: Log every request (parameters at INFO, prompts at DEBUG). Prompts may contain secrets.

catalog.label: Max logged prompt length
catalog.help: Truncate logged prompts and outputs to this many characters or tokens.

catalog.label: Disable FastAPI docs
catalog.help: Turn off /docs, /redoc and the OpenAPI schema.

catalog.label: Root path
catalog.help: FastAPI root_path, for use behind a path-routing proxy.

catalog.label: OTLP traces endpoint
catalog.help: Send OpenTelemetry traces to this URL (for example http://otel-collector:4317).

catalog.label: Log level
catalog.help: Sets VLLM_LOGGING_LEVEL, the verbosity of vLLM's own logs.

catalog.label: Enable LoRA
catalog.help: Serve LoRA adapters on top of the base model.

catalog.label: LoRA modules
catalog.help: Adapters as name=path (or JSON) entries; needs enable_lora.

catalog.label: Max LoRAs per batch
catalog.help: Adapters that can be active in one batch.

catalog.label: Max LoRA rank
catalog.help: Largest adapter rank accepted.

catalog.label: Max CPU LoRAs
catalog.help: Adapters cached in host RAM (at least max_loras).

catalog.label: LoRA dtype
catalog.help: dtype of the adapter weights; auto follows the base model.

catalog.label: Fully sharded LoRAs
catalog.help: Shard all LoRA math across tensor-parallel ranks (faster at high rank or large tensor-parallel size).

catalog.label: MFU metrics
catalog.help: Export estimated model FLOPs utilization metrics.

catalog.label: KV residency metrics
catalog.help: Sampled KV block lifetime and reuse histograms.

catalog.label: CUDA graph metrics
catalog.help: Padding and dispatch-mode metrics for CUDA graphs.

catalog.label: Show hidden metrics
catalog.help: Re-enable Prometheus metrics hidden since this version (for example 0.10) so old dashboards keep working.

catalog.label: KV transfer config (JSON)
catalog.help: Disaggregated prefill and KV connector configuration.

catalog.label: Additional platform config (JSON)
catalog.help: Platform-specific extra configuration.

catalog.label: Worker start method
catalog.help: Sets VLLM_WORKER_MULTIPROC_METHOD: how worker processes start (fork or spawn).
